flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

opportunities.point: Buying below the model's intrinsic value leaves room for a re-rating.
opportunities.evidence: DCF intrinsic 415 vs price 295 - margin of safety 28.9%

opportunities.point: The company expects top line value growth of 50% to 60% for the full year.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Management targets annual volume growth in the range of 30% to 40% compared to last year.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "So, if I have to go for the volume and the value, volume will remain largely in the 30% to 40% range and the value will remain in the 50% to 60% range as compared to last year." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Operations commenced at the company's new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai during Q1 FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Q1 FY27 was an important period for the company, particularly from an operational perspective, with the successful commencement of operations at our new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: The company allocated around INR 47 crores capex for its Jaipur facility, which is expected to be operational around November or December.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Expectations baked into the price are low, so little has to go right.
Rising institutional interest can keep supporting the price.
opportunities.evidence: POSITIVE MONEY FLOW - institutional holding change 0.36 pp

opportunities.point: India's jewellery market demand is driven by weddings, occasions, rising disposable incomes, and preference for organized brands.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "India's jewellery market is supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand, rising disposable incomes, and an increasable preference for organized and branded jewellery." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Management reported strong demand across export and local markets following recent industry exhibitions.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The demand is, as I said, we just exhibited from the exhibition and we've come and we have a huge demand in export as well as in local." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Capacity utilization at the existing Mumbai facility is currently at 75%.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "It's currently right now 75%." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Installed capacity post-commissioning across Andheri and Marol stands at approximately 6,700 kg per annum.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Installed capacity: ~6,700 kg pa (Andheri + Marol, post commissioning)" (concall ppt - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Management maintains its commitment to achieve 50% to 60% top line growth for the year.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01) [FY27]

threats.point: Expansion across regions, products, and export markets helps lower concentration risk.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Expansion across regions, products, and export markets reduces concentration risk" (concall ppt - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: Promoter selling is a warning about insider conviction.
Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.
threats.evidence: FII -0.46 pp, DII -2.37 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: The stock has drawn down sharply in the past.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Operating cash flow remains negative as the company maintains readily available stock rather than operating solely on an order-to-order basis.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The reason for being negative cash flow is like, we utilize all the funds and we keep the stock readily." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: Incorporation timeline for the Dubai subsidiary has been extended due to geopolitical situations and ongoing wars in the region.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "So due to all these wars and all, it is extended for a couple of months more ahead now because the situation, geopolitical things are not good." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

swot.verdict: Opportunities dominate the evidence (S24/W11/O29/T17), led by 'Buying below the model's intrinsic value leaves room for a re-rating', so the case leans on things that are not in the reported numbers yet.
